column6: Satellite ozone retrieval is a main remote-sensing-of-atmosphere application; knowing the ozone-hole chemistry gives the measurements meaning.
The Montreal Protocol is the standard case study of a successful transnational environmental regime.
Anthropogenic aerosols are mostly sulfate and other particles from air pollution; knowing their sources helps with their climate forcing.
Acid deposition and its buffering by bedrock and soils is a core environmental-geochemistry case.
Acid mine drainage from sulfide ores is a central environmental-geochemistry problem.
IP surveys are used mainly to explore for disseminated sulfide ore deposits.
Climate models share dynamical cores, grids and parameterizations with NWP models.
GCMs use the same discretized primitive equations and parameterizations introduced in NWP.
The solar wind and CMEs that drive magnetospheres originate in the corona and solar activity.
Solar variability is driven by the sunspot and magnetic cycle described in the solar-structure topic.
Auroral storms are triggered by CMEs and high-speed solar wind streams from solar activity.
Earth's oxygenation history is the reference case for how life changes a planet's atmosphere.
O₂ and O₃ as biosignatures rest on Earth's Great Oxidation Event record.
Glacial erosion and deposition draw upon how glaciers form and flow.
Ice-age cycles are the growth and decay of ice sheets; glacier mass balance is the underlying mechanism.
Ice-sheet coupling assumes accumulation, ablation, flow and isostatic response.
Ice-core air bubbles are trapped during the snow-to-firn-to-ice transformation taught here.
Climate feedbacks are interactions among the atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere and biosphere introduced here.
DEMs are the digital form of contour-map elevation data; contour reading, slope and profiles carry over.
Landform analysis relies on reading relief, gradient and drainage from topographic maps.
GPS geodesy applies the GNSS positioning principles (pseudorange, carrier phase, differential methods).
Synthetic seismograms are built from sonic and density well logs.
